checks.claim: Schema contracts are declared and enforced at each boundary.
checks.evidence_required: The schema/contract definitions and a run where a contract violation is rejected.
checks.how_to_run: Read the contracts; run the pipeline tests and quote a rejected bad record.
checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.

source.quote: Schema contracts declared + enforced at each boundary

checks.evidence_required: Two consecutive runs with identical row counts and no duplicates on the unique key.
checks.how_to_run: Run the pipeline twice against the target (or DuckDB) and quote both row counts and a duplicate-key query.
checks.honesty_note: Scaffolded but not run against a real or DuckDB target: NOT_RUN; never claim idempotency that was not executed.

source.quote: a rerun proven to produce no duplicates (idempotency evidence)

checks.honesty_note: If the runtime, account, device or sandbox needed for this proof is missing, mark NOT_RUN and say why; never PASS on a description.
